subject: world_language
concept: Combining persuasive writing, complex sentences, formal correspondence, revision, and presentation skills into an extended real-world project, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans an extended project combining written and spoken components
exercise.abstract: Student completes an extended project combining a written piece and an oral presentation, applying this unit's full skill set

assessment.mastery_threshold: project demonstrates at least four of this unit's skill areas working together coherently
misconception_flags: completes the written and spoken components without genuinely connecting them into one coherent project

interest_binding: project topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
